mapper.insert: insert into ai_chat_conversation(session_id, user_id, title) values (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{title}) on duplicate key update updated_at = if(user_id = values(user_id), current_timestamp, updated_at)
mapper.select: select id, session_id, user_id, title, summary, summarized_through_id, created_at, updated_at from ai_chat_conversation where user_id = #{userId} order by updated_at desc, id desc
select id, session_id, user_id, title, summary, summarized_through_id, created_at, updated_at from ai_chat_conversation where session_id = #{sessionId}
